nodes.description: Address holding admin role, set to msg.sender and minted initial supply in CHBToken constructor.
ERC20 private mapping tracking token balances per account.
ERC20 private total supply counter modified on mint and burn.
ERC20 nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Public function that burns caller tokens and emits a TransferToNative event for the native chain.
Constructor that assigns _admin = msg.sender, sets decimals and mints 100e18 tokens to the admin.
External view function requiring blockNumber < block.number but declaring no return value, so every call reverts.
Internal burn routine that subtracts from _balances and _totalSupply and emits Transfer to address(0).
Virtual hook invoked before every mint, burn and transfer; may be overridden by inheriting contracts.
ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decreases the caller allowance.
Caller-supplied address used as admin at deployment and as the burn source in transferToNative.
State-changing burn invocation executed inside the public transferToNative function using caller-controlled value.
Event emission of the user supplied destination and amount in the native-chain bridge flow.
Destination address on the native chain supplied to transferToNative.
Amount of tokens to burn, supplied by the caller of transferToNative.
Minter address argument of the CHBToken constructor.
Block number argument compared against block.number in getPriorVotes.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit caller and burn source used by transferToNative.
msg.sender becomes _admin at deployment, granting unconditional admin privileges.
minter parameter is consumed by the constructor, which mints the initial supply.
Constructor mints the initial supply into the _balances mapping.
Constructor mint increases _totalSupply.
to parameter flows into the TransferToNative event emitted by transferToNative.
value parameter flows into the burn invocation in transferToNative.
value is deducted from the caller balance inside _burn.
transferToNative unconditionally calls _burn(msg.sender, value).
transferToNative emits TransferToNative after burning.
The burn operation writes to the _balances mapping.
The burn operation reduces _totalSupply.
_burn reads _balances[sender] and subtracts the amount, a state-mutating arithmetic step.
_burn subtracts the amount from _totalSupply.
The burn path invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, which may be overridden by a malicious inheritor and reenter.
_burn calls the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
transferFrom updates balances through _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the caller allowance in _allowances.
blockNumber is compared against block.number inside getPriorVotes.
msg.sender is passed as the account to be burned in the unsafe burn operation.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter is only meaningful as the native-chain destination used when transferToNative emits its event.
The value parameter is a transient argument whose only effect is the burn and event inside transferToNative.
The minter parameter is consumed solely by the constructor's admin assignment and initial mint.
The blockNumber parameter is used only in the comparison performed by getPriorVotes.
